blocks.text: COTABATO CITY, BARMM, Philippines — The leader of the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) on Tuesday invited business leaders and development partners to invest in the region, saying the gains of the peace process must now translate into jobs, better incomes, growing enterprises, and safe and secure communities. “The Bangsamoro is ready to take its next step, from peace to prosperity. We invite you to take that step with us,” BARMM interim Chief Minister Abdulraof Macacua said in his message at the 2026 Mindanao Development Forum held in Davao City and livestreamed on social media.
